skill_name: Explain the trade-offs of a decision-tree algorithm
workflow: The decision tree algorithm has several trade-offs that must be considered. The main advantages of the decision tree algorithm is that it can be easily and quickly understood, requires relatively little data preparation and is able to handle both continuous and categorical data. However, decision trees are prone to overfitting, where the model is overly complex and fits the training data too closely. This can lead to poor generalization performance on unseen datasets.
